title: Preallocate composite index prefixes
description: Avoid intermediate joined-column allocation when composite index key and scan paths build index:<table>:<columns>: prefixes from known name lengths.
implementation: Replaced composite_index_prefix() format! plus columns.join(",") with one explicit-capacity String.
Pushed comma-separated columns directly into the prefix buffer.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Composite index prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table and column name lengths while preserving composite index key generation, prefix/range scans, and SQL results.
